endpoints.name: List user
endpoints.description: Directory users, including members and guests. Use explicit selected properties for account state and organizational attributes.
endpoints.notes:
## Parameters
* $top (query, optional): Show only the first n items
* $search (query, optional): Search items by search phrases
* $filter (query, optional): Filter items by property values
* $count (query, optional): Include count of items
* $orderby (query, optional): Order items by property values
* $select (query, optional): Select properties to be returned

## Response
* JSON collection of user. Useful fields: id, displayName, userPrincipalName, mail, givenName, surname, accountEnabled, userType, department, jobTitle, employeeId, createdDateTime, onPremisesExtensionAttributes.
* Successful reads return status=success, data=list, complete=boolean. Graph wire collections use a value array; single-object reads return the object directly.
* The adapter consumes value/continuation metadata and returns data with unchanged Graph field names. A sample is not a complete inventory. Omitted fields remain unknown.
* Failed reads return status=error, error=message, error_code=code, http_status=number or null, complete=false. Never interpret a failure as empty data.

## Interpretation and Related Data
Object id is the stable directory identifier. userPrincipalName is a sign-in name; mail can be absent and differs from UPN. accountEnabled is an account setting, not proof of successful sign-in or effective access. userType distinguishes Member and Guest. Missing properties remain unknown; never coerce missing accountEnabled to false. Membership and enterprise-app assignments require their own relationships.

## Retrieval Notes
* Application permission: User.Read.All. Availability still depends on tenant features and consent.
The default user response contains only a basic property subset. Select the properties needed by the question; department and accountEnabled require selection. List does not support $skip. Default page size is 100, maximum 999; signInActivity queries have a lower 500 maximum and additional permissions. This catalog omits signInActivity; use bounded sign-in reads for event evidence. Several personal profile properties are only available on the single-user operation. Directory/schema extensions and onPremisesExtensionAttributes require $select; open extensions use a different mechanism and are outside this initial contract. Recent changes can lag in queries.
* Page size is not a total count. The adapter handles paging. Check status and complete; preserve errors rather than returning an empty list.
* OData string literals escape an apostrophe by doubling it. Pass parameters separately; do not construct an absolute URL. Keep all requests read only.
